name: Red Burlap Bandana
summary: Red Burlap Bandanas are the crude, dyed cloth masks worn by low-ranking highwaymen and cutpurses of the Defias Brotherhood. In Northshire Valley, Deputy Willem collects these pieces of cloth as proof of slain thieves encroaching near the abbey vineyards.

sections.title: A Mark of the Brotherhood
sections.body: Worn across the lower face, the red burlap bandana serves as the identifying badge of the Defias Brotherhood's rank-and-file. Made from cheap, rough fabric and soaked in red dye, the cloth conceals a thief's features while signaling allegiance to the growing rebellion. In Northshire, young recruits and common thugs carry these scarves into the eastern orchards, unaware that the local guards use the striking red fabric as a grim bounty marker.

faq.q: Why does Deputy Willem want these bandanas?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem collects the bandanas as tangible proof that an adventurer has eliminated the Defias thugs encroaching across the river near Northshire Abbey. Because the thieves openly wear the red cloth, bringing them in serves as confirmation of bounties paid on the local highwaymen.

faq.q: Who wears the red burlap bandanas?
faq.answer: They are worn by footpads and thugs affiliated with the Defias Brotherhood, a ring of organized outlaws active throughout Elwynn Forest and Westfall. The coarse red fabric acts as both a disguise and an emblem of loyalty to their underground guild.

faq.q: Why are Defias thieves operating in Northshire?
faq.answer: Defias scouts and brigands have set up camps across the stream east of Northshire Abbey to scavenge, steal supplies, and monitor traffic leaving Stormwind City. The garrison at the abbey is stretched thin, allowing low-level highwaymen to roam the nearby orchards.

The bandanas are simply pieces of cheap burlap treated with crimson dye. The distinctive color acts as the official banner and uniform of the Defias Brotherhood, ensuring fellow members recognize one another in the field.

angles.text: For a developing rogue, stripping red masks from Northshire's clumsy footpads is a lesson in how quickly undisciplined outlaws make themselves easy targets for local law enforcement.
The spread of these red bandanas to the very doorstep of Northshire Abbey shows how severely the kingdom's rural borders are slipping out of Stormwind's control.
